Căn hộ khách sạn (condotel) là căn hộ tr: A hotel apartment (condotel) is a unit in a building operated as a hotel: the buyer owns the unit, hands it to a management company to rent out, and shares the revenue or receives a guaranteed return. Da Nang has one of the largest numbers of condotels in the country, concentrated along the Vo Nguyen Giap – Truong Sa coast (Son Tra, Ngu Hanh Son), along the Han River and in Hoi An. Điểm khác căn hộ chung cư: condotel thườ: How they differ from regular apartments: condotels are usually on commercial-service land, so ownership has a term (commonly 50 years) rather than being freehold; certificate issuance has been slow at many projects. Some projects have stopped paying guaranteed returns, some were built in breach of permits or are converting their function to apartments. According to the press, Da Nang is currently restricting new condotel licenses, so most products on the list are handed-over units traded as resales.
